fullPassage: When we realize we've said something in error and we pause to go back to correct it, we stop gesturing a couple of hundred milliseconds before we stop speaking. Such sequences suggest the startling notion that our hands 'know' what we're going to say before our conscious minds do, and in fact this is often the case. Gesture can mentally prime a word so that the right term comes to our lips. When people are prevented from gesturing, they talk less fluently; their speech becomes halting because their hands are no longer able to supply them with the next word, and the next. Not being able to gesture has other deleterious effects: without gesture to help our mental processes along, we remember less useful information, we solve problems less well, and we are less able to explain our thinking. Far from tagging along as speech's clumsy companion, gesture represents the leading edge of our thought.

det.korean: 몸짓은 사고의 선도적 가장자리(the leading edge of our thought)를 나타낸다
det.analysis:
❌ ① the startling notion: FP 구절. 놀라운 개념은 sequences가 suggest하는 대상이지 gesture가 represent하는 대상이 아님
✅ ② the leading edge of our thought: 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ other deleterious effects: FP 구절. 해로운 효과는 몸짓 못하는 결과이지 몸짓이 나타내는 것이 아님
❌ ④ our mental processes: FP 구절. 정신 과정은 몸짓이 돕는 대상이지 나타내는 대상이 아님
det.tip: gesture represents the leading edge of our thought = 사고의 선도적 가장자리

ch: the leading edge of our thought

questions.passage: When we realize we've said something in error and we pause to go back to correct it, we stop gesturing a couple of hundred milliseconds before we stop speaking. Such sequences suggest the startling notion that our hands 'know' what we're going to say before our conscious minds do, and in fact this is often the case. Gesture can mentally prime a word so that the right term comes to our lips. When people are prevented from gesturing, they talk less fluently; their speech becomes halting because their hands are no longer able to supply them with the next word, and the next. Not being able to gesture has other deleterious effects: without gesture to help our mental processes along, we remember less useful information, we solve problems less well, and we are less able to explain our thinking. Far from tagging along as __________, gesture represents the leading edge of our thought.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 몸짓은 단순히 말의 서투른 동반자(speech's clumsy companion)가 아니라 사고의 선도적 가장자리이다
det.analysis:
❌ ① the right term: FP 구절. 적절한 용어는 gesture가 prime하는 대상이지 Far from의 대상이 아님
✅ ② speech's clumsy companion: 원문 일치. Far from tagging along as ___ ←정답
❌ ③ our conscious minds: FP 구절. 의식적 마음은 hands가 먼저 아는 대상이지 비유 대상이 아님
❌ ④ less useful information: FP 구절. 덜 유용한 정보는 몸짓 없을 때 기억하는 결과이지 비유 대상이 아님
det.tip: Far from tagging along as speech's clumsy companion = 말의 서투른 동반자로 따라다니기는커녕
